edges_note: An edge exists only where a public signature, return annotation, README/docstring statement, or import-with-use names the type; evidence is file:line in that repo. Empty consumes/produces means no robot_msgs type appears in the public API (verified by grepping src for robot_msgs imports): robot_thermal has no robot_msgs import at all (stdlib core with its own BurstState/ThermalEstimate; the 'msgs' extra is declared but unused in src); robot_diagnostics uses its own data.Trajectory (arrays, src/robot_diagnostics/data.py:36) and reaches robot_metrics and sim2real only lazily via the stock extra; robot_metrics outputs its own records (records.py:7 says a robot_msgs message comes later). robot_msgs and robot_models are not drawn as consumers of anything beyond the listed items; no tests were run.
